description: A compiler for software architecture: loko compiles a C4 model from HCL (*.loko.hcl) into D2 and SVG diagrams, markdown, a static site, graph queries, JSON or TOON exports, and an MCP server for describing, querying, validating and editing the architecture.
rules: An architecture is written in *.loko.hcl files with exactly one project block. There is no loko.toml, no markdown frontmatter model and no hand-written D2; those belonged to the 0.x releases.
Relationships are uses blocks nested inside their source element, and references are bare traversals such as container.api, never quoted strings.
Run loko validate after every change; it reports every error with file, line and column. Use loko fmt for canonical formatting.
Through MCP, change the architecture with the apply_edit and move tools, which compile every edit before writing, instead of editing files directly.
There are no loko init, loko new, loko api or loko watch commands; loko serve rebuilds on change, and loko build needs no d2 binary.
